text_en: The words of King Lemuel. An oracle that his mother taught him:
text_cn: 玛萨的君王肋慕耳的格言，是他母亲教给他的：

text_en: No, my son! No, son of my womb! No, son of my vows!
text_cn: 我儿！我的亲生儿！我的长子肋慕耳！我许愿所得的孩子！我可给你说些什么？

text_en: Do not give your strength to women, your ways to those who destroy kings.
text_cn: 你不要将你的精力，为女人而消耗；也不要为君王的宫女，白费你的血气。

text_en: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to desire strong drink;
text_cn: 肋慕耳！清酒不宜于君王，醇酒不宜于公侯。

text_en: or else they will drink and forget what has been decreed, and will pervert the rights of all the afflicted.
text_cn: 免得在酒兴之余，轻易将法律忘掉，颠倒穷人的是非。

text_en: Give strong drink to one who is perishing, and wine to those in bitter distress;
text_cn: 应将醇酒给与哀恸(tòng)欲绝的人，应将清酒给与心灵痛楚的人，

text_en: let them drink and forget their poverty, and remember their misery no more.
text_cn: 好叫他们喝了，完全忘掉自己的贫乏，不再记忆自己的忧苦。

text_en: Speak out for those who cannot speak, for the rights of all the destitute.
text_cn: 你应为哑巴开口，为被弃的人辩护；

text_en: Speak out, judge righteously, defend the rights of the poor and needy.
text_cn: 你应开口秉公行审，应为贫苦弱小辩护。

text_en: A capable wife who can find? She is far more precious than jewels.
text_cn: 贤淑的妇女，有谁能找到？她本身价值，远胜过珠宝。

text_en: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he will have no lack of gain.
text_cn: 她的丈夫对她衷心信赖，一切所需从来不会缺少。

text_en: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
text_cn: 她一生岁月，只叫他幸福，不给他烦恼。

text_en: She seeks wool and flax, and works with willing hands.
text_cn: 她弄来羊毛细麻，愉快地亲手劳作。

text_en: She is like the ships of the merchant, she brings her food from far away.
text_cn: 她宛如一只商船，由远处运来食粮。

text_en: She rises while it is still night and provides food for her household and tasks for her servant-girls.
text_cn: 天还未明，她已起身，为给家人分配食物，给婢女们分派家务。

text_en: She considers a field and buys it; with the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.
text_cn: 她看中一块田地，就将它买了来，以双手所得的收入，栽植了葡萄园。

text_en: She girds herself with strength, and makes her arms strong.
text_cn: 她以勇力束腰，增强自己臂力。

text_en: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp does not go out at night.
text_cn: 她发觉自己经营生利，她的灯盏夜间仍不熄灭。

text_en: She puts her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
text_cn: 她手执纺锤，手指旋转纱锭(dìng)。

text_en: She opens her hand to the poor, and reaches out her hands to the needy.
text_cn: 对贫苦的人，她随手赒济；对无靠的人，她伸手扶助。

text_en: She is not afraid for her household when it snows, for all her household are clothed in crimson.
text_cn: 为自己的家人，她不害怕风雪，因为全家上下，都穿双料衣裳。

text_en: She makes herself coverings; her clothing is fine linen and purple.
text_cn: 她为自己做华丽的铺盖，身穿的是细麻和紫锦的衣裳。

text_en: Her husband is known in the city gates, taking his seat among the elders of the land.
text_cn: 她的丈夫与当地长老同席，在城门口深为众人所认识。

text_en: She makes linen garments and sells them; she supplies the merchant with sashes.
text_cn: 她纺织纱布予以出售，又制造腰带卖与商贾。

text_en: Strength and dignity are her clothing, and she laughs at the time to come.
text_cn: 刚毅和尊严是她的服饰，一念及将来便笑容满面。

text_en: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.
text_cn: 她一开口即倾吐智慧，舌上常有仁慈的训诲。

text_en: She looks well to the ways of her household, and does not eat the bread of idleness.
text_cn: 她不断督察家务，从不白吃闲饭。

text_en: Her children rise up and call her happy; her husband too, and he praises her:
text_cn: 她的子女起来向她祝福，她的丈夫对她赞不绝口：

text_en: “Many women have done excellently, but you surpass them all. ”
text_cn: “贤淑的女子很多，唯有你超群出众。”

text_en: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain, but a woman who fears the Lord is to be praised.
text_cn: 姿色是虚幻，美丽是泡影；敬畏上主的女人，才堪当受人赞美。

text_en: Give her a share in the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her in the city gates.
text_cn: 愿她享受她双手操劳的成果！愿她的事业在城门口使她受赞扬！
